Name: Joash, the Abiezrite
Summary: Joash the Abiezrite, of Ophrah, was Gideon's father; when the men of the city demanded Gideon's death for breaking down Baal's altar, Joash defended him, saying Baal could plead for himself.
KeyStory: Joash owned the altar Gideon tore down, and when the townsmen came for his son, he answered that if Baal were a god he could plead his own cause — and Gideon was called Jerubbaal from that day.
LifeLesson: A father's courage can be as simple as refusing to kill his son for a god who cannot defend itself.
